title: Watch: Nasa astronauts conduct 6.5-hour spacewalk outside ISS
summary_full: Astronauts Anil Menon and Jessica Meir ventured out to install a mounting hardware for the future addition of solar arrays to the space station.
summary_public: Astronauts Anil Menon and Jessica Meir ventured out to install a mounting hardware for the future addition of solar arrays to the space station.
